plan.risks: The headroom raises the worst-case per-call output spend from 6000 to 16000 tokens; acceptable for a manually-dispatched agent with no scheduled volume, and unused headroom is unbilled. Above ~16000 HTTP timeouts replace truncation as the failure mode, which is why the ceiling was not set higher. If the queued after-leg run shows output_tokens == 16000 the report is still CUT and that becomes a new finding, not a config tweak.
